name: Agent tools (MCP)
description: Turns the abilities the TV's apps and add-ons sign into MCP tools a language model can call.
about: One bridge between the TV and a language model, built on a scheme instead of a fixed list. Installed apps and add-ons sign the scheme with a small tools.json that names their abilities; this add-on turns each into an MCP tool and answers list and call over JSON-RPC at /api/addons/agent/mcp. An app can become a launch tool, a service add-on a set of tools that call its own endpoints, an external service a tool that calls an address. The voice assistant, or any MCP client, can then use those tools to act on the TV.
